parsed_output.overall_summary: This meme humorously applies Newton's First Law of Motion (Inertia) to explain why it is easier to stay awake late than it is to wake up early. It features a text-based question and answer followed by a high-energy reaction image of David Tennant as the Tenth Doctor from Doctor Who shouting 'PHYSICS'. The main takeaway is a relatable joke about sleep cycles framed through a scientific lens.

people.description: David Tennant as the Tenth Doctor, wearing glasses and a suit in a classroom setting, looking upwards and shouting.

entities.name: Newton's First Law of Motion
entities.specifications: An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.

takeaways.statement: The difficulty of changing sleep states (staying awake vs. waking up) can be humorously compared to the physical property of inertia.
